structure.note: Ordinary Shares plus unlisted Restricted Shares (held by Altria and BEVCO, convertible one-for-one into Ordinary Shares and ranking equally for dividends and votes); the 20-F states that 'Shares held by our major shareholders do not entitle such shareholders to different voting rights.' The controlling shareholder is the Stichting, which represents the founding Belgian families of Interbrew (mainly through EPS, holding class A certificates) and the Brazilian families that previously controlled Ambev (through BRC, holding class B certificates). At December 31, 2025 BRC's and EPS/EPS Participations' certificates each indirectly represented 16.99% of the shares. The Stichting and the entities acting in concert with it held 39.50% in aggregate. Under the 2023 Shareholders' Agreement BRC and EPS jointly control the Stichting, which nominates eight board candidates. It holds under 50% of the votes, so 'controlled' is false under this site's >50%-of-votes definition.

notes: Fiscal year ended 31 December 2025. Source is AB InBev's Annual Report on Form 20-F 2025 (accession 0001193125-26-088105, filed March 3, 2026), read on sec.gov; IFRS, USD, converted exactly from USD millions. Buybacks, stock comp and taxes match SEC XBRL companyfacts (CIK 0001668717). LEADER: Marcel Herrmann Telles is not named anywhere in the FY2025 20-F. The major-shareholder notes name Max Van Hoegaerden Herrmann Telles (with Jorge Paulo Lemann and Carlos Alberto da Veiga Sicupira) as controlling BRC S.à.R.L., the Brazilian families' vehicle that holds the Stichting's class B certificates (indirectly 16.99% of the shares) and 1.40% of the shares directly. The filing does not describe Marcel Herrmann Telles's own interest or his relation to Max, so status is 'no-reported-stake' and no BRC stake is attributed to him; relation 'investor' follows the site's role label. HOLDERS: all percentages are calculated, as the 20-F states, 'on the total number of outstanding shares as of 31 December 2025 (2,019,241,973 shares) minus the number of outstanding shares held in treasury' (68,489,754), i.e. they exclude treasury shares. The Stichting's 33.99% already contains BRC's and EPS's certificate interests, so BRC (1.40% direct) and EPS Participations (3.45% direct) are not listed, to avoid mixing direct and look-through figures. Altria's 8.15% and BEVCO's 5.28% are the 20-F's all-inclusive aggregates (Restricted plus Ordinary Shares) from notes (7) and (8); Altria's ordinary-share count still rests on the 13D dated 20 March 2024. The Stichting is typed 'family' because it represents the founding Belgian families and the Brazilian families; it is a Dutch foundation. DIVIDENDS: USD 2,466 million recognised as dividends to equity holders of AB InBev in the statement of changes in equity. The cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' of USD (4,543) million includes dividends paid by Ambev and other subsidiaries to minority holders; the MD&A says 2025 dividends paid 'consisted primarily of USD 2.6 billion paid by Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV and USD 1.9 billion paid by Ambev and to minorities'. BUYBACKS: USD 2,301 million 'Share buyback' (cash flow), completing the USD 2 billion programme announced in 2024 and USD 0.4 billion of the USD 6 billion programme approved on 29 October 2025. STOCK COMP: USD 625 million; all plans are equity-settled. No broad employee share plan is described (plans cover senior management and directors), so plan is null. GEOGRAPHY: revenue by reporting segment (USD 59,320 million); the segments are the five geographic regions plus Global Export and Holding Companies.
